Direct answer | the Grinding and Polishing Workers, Hand on this page are the precise occupation O*NET 51-9022.00 (Grinding and Polishing Workers, Hand), and the work can be divided into several categories: (one) drawing reading and preparation — studying blueprints or layout drawings to determine workpiece placement or saw out templates, measuring and marking equipment and objects or parts to ensure grinding and polishing standards are met, and selecting files or other abrasives according to material and size and shape and removal allowance and the specified surface quality and finishing process; (two) grinding and sanding and polishing — using hand tools and power tools to grind, sand, clean, or polish objects or parts to correct defects or prepare them for further finishing, operating controls to adjust and start or stop equipment, and loading and adjusting workpieces with hand tools; (three) trimming and deburring and filing — using chisels and scrapers and other hand tools to trim, scrape, or deburr objects or parts, and filing grooves and contours and irregular surfaces of metal dies and machine parts and the like to meet template and layout drawing or blueprint specifications; (four) defect marking and rework — marking defects such as knots and cracks and splits so they can be repaired, and reworking or segregating and registering them according to the defect; (five) inspection and recording — verifying the quality of finished parts by inspecting and comparing with templates, measuring dimensions, or testing in operating equipment, taking finished parts off the equipment or workbench and placing them into containers, and recording product and processing data on the designated forms; (six) tooling maintenance and surface treatment — repairing and maintaining equipment and objects or parts with hand tools, sharpening grinding tools with machine and hand tools, applying solutions and chemicals to equipment and objects or parts with hand tools, and cleaning brass chips out of file teeth with a file brush. Work cycle linkage: drawing reading and material and abrasive selection — clamping and rough grinding and stock removal — fine grinding and polishing and finishing — inspection and template comparison and measurement — defect marking and rework or segregation — recording and handover and tooling maintenance. subject.summary: Grinding and Polishing Workers, Hand corresponds to U.S. 51-9022.00, grinding, sanding, and polishing multiple materials by hand or with hand-held power tools, checking dimensions / appearance, marking defects, and maintaining tools. The hand designation does not exclude fixed equipment; distinction from machine tool grinders / tool and die makers is made by real tasks. BLS current 2025—2035 employment for the precise occupation 51-9022 goes from 10.8→8.7 thousand, a change of −19.2%, a net change of −2.1 thousand, and an average of 0.7 thousand annual openings from replacements; each figure is rounded independently, and EP includes self-employment (2.5% in 2025) and differs from OEWS wages. Projections are not actual hiring, individual outcomes, or AI causality. O*NET still shows the prior 2024—2034 base period of 11,800 / decline of 1% or more / 800, which is not used as the current projection.
